How pages earn their place

Every page on CRI carries a visible publication status. Published means editorially reviewed with sources listed. Technical review pending means editorially complete, with subject-matter verification still open — and the page says so. Draft work is excluded from search, from promotion, and from this homepage until its sources are verified.

The full framework is public: editorial standards, methodology, and a corrections policy that fixes errors in the open.

Why trust CRI

Built like a reference institution, governed like one

Independent

Editorial decisions are made solely by our editors, under public standards. CRI sells no roofing work and accepts no payment for coverage. Every relationship is disclosed.

Sourced, and honest about the gaps

Published pages list the documents behind them, and say plainly where the evidence runs out. Where our own data is not yet validated, we mark it and decline to publish a number rather than dress up a guess. See our methodology.

Accountable

Review dates on every page. A named editor behind every review. Errors fixed in public under our corrections policy.

When reading isn't enough

Want eyes on your actual roof?

Guides answer the general question. A written condition report with photos answers yours — what is actually up there, what needs attention, and what can wait.

CRI arranges complimentary commercial roof assessments: a documented walk of the roof, photographs, and a written condition report that is yours to keep — whether or not any work ever follows. No obligation, and no pressure standard: partners who pitch during an assessment lose the referral relationship.

Disclosure: assessments may be performed by Victory E&I Roofing and Construction LLC, which shares common ownership with CRI. If you later choose to engage a partner for work, CRI may receive a referral fee — this is how the free platform is funded, documented under Funding & Relationships. CRI is an independent educational platform and performs no roofing work itself.

What you get A documented roof walk, photos, and a written condition report — plus the knowledge base to read it against.
